brief:
President Trump threatened military action against Oman if the country obstructs his Iran policy, The Guardian reported. Trump made the remarks during an interview with Fox News as his son-in-law Jared Kushner met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Jerusalem to advance a Gaza peace proposal.

The timing of Kushner's visit underscores the administration's dual focus on Middle East diplomacy. Trump has signaled an aggressive approach to Iran negotiations since resuming office, while simultaneously pushing efforts to broker a ceasefire and settlement agreement in Gaza. Netanyahu and Kushner's discussions represent the latest diplomatic push to resolve the ongoing conflict.
